definitions: To form or make up (a whole) from parts or elements.
To create or write (a piece of music or writing).
To calm or settle (one's mind or oneself).
To arrange (type or images) for printing or display.
examples: The committee is composed of members from various departments.
She spent hours composing a new song.
He took a moment to compose himself before speaking.
The designer will compose the layout for the magazine.
